words.zh: 裝卸區（貨車停靠的地方）

pairs.note: vest 上排牙齒輕碰下唇再發聲；west 兩片嘴唇圓起來，牙齒不碰嘴唇。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, you must be from the office. I'm Luis.
scene.zh: 嗨，你一定是辦公室那邊來的吧。我是 Luis。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Ms. Carter asked me to help out here this month.
scene.zh: Ms. Carter 請我這個月來這邊幫忙。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. We're a small operation, so we could use the help.
scene.zh: 太好了。我們這裡人手不多，正需要人幫忙。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This place is huge, so where do I start?
scene.zh: 這裡好大，我要從哪裡開始？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let's walk around first. This is our only dock.
scene.zh: 我們先走一圈。這是我們唯一的裝卸區。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every truck that picks up or drops off goods stops here.
scene.zh: 來載貨、送貨的貨車都停在這裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's our stock over there. Three big shipments go out this week.
scene.zh: 那邊是我們的庫存。這禮拜有三批大貨要出。

fills.en: I counted again, but the numbers still don't ___.
fills.zh: 我又數了一次，數字還是對不起來。

fills.en: Should I ___ it on the inventory list?
fills.zh: 我要在庫存清單上註記一下嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, today we count the stock, one category at a time.
scene.zh: 好，今天我們盤點庫存，一個類別一個類別來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The list says five dozen small lamps on this rack. Count them twice.
scene.zh: 清單上寫這座貨架上有五打小檯燈。數兩次確認一下。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I counted again, but the numbers still don't match.
scene.zh: 我又數了一次，數字還是對不起來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Wait. That box on the top shelf is empty. That's the problem.
scene.zh: 等一下，最上層那個箱子是空的，問題就在這裡。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I mark it on the inventory list?
scene.zh: 我要在庫存清單上註記一下嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Mark it, and write the real number next to it.
scene.zh: 對，註記起來，然後在旁邊寫上實際的數量。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then we'll move on to the large lamps.
scene.zh: 然後我們再去數大檯燈。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Next is packing. This order is just two lamps.
scene.zh: 接下來是包裝。這張訂單只有兩盞燈。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How are small orders like this usually packed?
scene.zh: 像這種小訂單通常怎麼包？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: First, we wrap each lamp in plastic to protect the glass.
scene.zh: 首先，每盞燈都用塑膠包起來，保護玻璃。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then measure it and pick a box that fits.
scene.zh: 然後量一下尺寸，挑一個剛好的箱子。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Seal it well, and always put a Fragile label on top.
scene.zh: 封箱要封好，上面一定要貼「易碎」標籤。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Wait, look at these boxes. They don't have labels.
scene.zh: 等等，你看這幾箱，都沒貼標籤。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Were these boxes packed by the same person?
scene.zh: 這幾箱是同一個人包的嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, they were packed by Tom on Friday. I'll talk to him.
scene.zh: 對，是 Tom 星期五包的。我再去跟他說。

passages.title: Warehouse Safety Rules
lines: To prevent accidents and keep everyone safe, please follow these rules.
1. Safety equipment: Wear gloves when you pack or move boxes. Glass can cut your hands. You can find gloves in the cabinet by the door.
2. Be aware of trucks: Trucks come in and out of the dock all day. Look before you walk across.
3. Use a ladder to reach the top shelf. Never stand on boxes or racks.
4. A wet floor is not safe. If you see water or oil, clean it up right away. Then put out the sign to warn other people.
5. Emergencies: When you hear the fire alarm, stop work, leave by the nearest door, and meet in front of the office. Do not go back for your things.

options: In the cabinet by the door

questions.en: What should you do if you see water on the floor?
questions.zh: 看到地上有水，應該怎麼做？
options: Clean it and put out a sign

questions.en: What must you NOT do when the fire alarm rings?
questions.zh: 火災警報響的時候，「不可以」做什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hold on! Where are your gloves?
scene.zh: 等一下！你的手套呢？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, I wasn't aware of the rule about gloves.
scene.zh: 不好意思，我不知道有戴手套的規定。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's okay. Did you read the sign by the door?
scene.zh: 沒關係。你有看門邊那張告示嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Glass can cut your hands, so always wear gloves in here.
scene.zh: 那些玻璃會割傷手，所以在這裡一定要戴手套。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We store them in that cabinet over there. Take a pair.
scene.zh: 手套都放在那邊的櫃子裡，拿一雙去戴。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We want everyone to go home safe at the end of the day.
scene.zh: 我們希望每個人下班都能平平安安回家。

lines.en: This order is for a shop downtown, and it can't be late.
lines.zh: 這張訂單是市中心一家店的，不能遲到。

lines.en: Okay. When does it need to go out?
It has to leave before two o'clock.
Got it. Which truck should I put it on?
lines.zh: 了解。那我要把它放上哪一台車？

lines.en: Check the schedule on the wall first.
lines.zh: 你先看一下牆上的時刻表。

lines.en: Then move the boxes to the dock.
lines.zh: 然後把箱子搬到裝卸區。

lines.en: Sure. I'll do that right now.

questions.en: Which truck will take the order?
questions.zh: 這張訂單會上哪一台車？

questions.en: What does Luis say to do first?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, the trucks are coming. We have multiple orders going out today.
scene.zh: 好，貨車快來了。我們今天有好幾張訂單要出。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you want me to load the rush order first?
scene.zh: 要我先裝那張急單嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, please. It's for the store downtown, and it can't be late.
scene.zh: 好，麻煩你。那是市中心那家店的，不能遲到。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which truck does this order go on?
scene.zh: 這張訂單要上哪一台車？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Truck B. It's waiting out in the yard right now.
scene.zh: B 車。它現在在外面的場地等。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's almost at maximum capacity. Don't stack the boxes more than three high.
scene.zh: 那台車快到載重上限了。箱子最多疊三層，不要再高。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And lift with your legs, not your back.
scene.zh: 還有，抬東西要用腿出力，不要用腰。

textFills.title: The missing box
lines: This morning, ___ of the boxes for the Lake Street order were on the dock, but one was missing.
We found it later behind the door. Please do a ___ check before a truck leaves.
Our inventory list must be ___, so there is never a shortage for a customer.
zh: 今天早上，Lake Street 那張訂單的箱子大部分都在裝卸區，但是少了一箱。
後來我們在門後面找到了。貨車出發前，請大家仔細檢查一遍。
我們的庫存清單一定要準確，客戶才不會收到短少的貨。

blanks.note: most of the + 複數名詞 = 大部分的……
thorough check = 仔細徹底的檢查。
清單要「準確」才不會少貨。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Before it goes on the truck, let's inspect the order.
scene.zh: 裝上車之前，我們先檢查一下這張訂單。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Most of the order is here, but one box is missing.
scene.zh: 這張訂單的貨大部分都在，但是少了一箱。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Missing? Boxes don't just disappear. Who handled it?
scene.zh: 少一箱？箱子不會自己不見啊。是誰經手的？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The box we need has a yellow tag on it.
scene.zh: 我們要找的那箱上面有黃色吊牌。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: None of these boxes have a yellow tag.
scene.zh: 這幾箱都沒有黃色吊牌。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, let's do a thorough check of the whole dock.
scene.zh: 好，那我們把整個裝卸區徹底找一遍。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Our count has to be accurate. No customer wants a shortage.
scene.zh: 我們的數量一定要準確。沒有客戶想收到短少的貨。

lines.en: Attention, please. This is a message for everyone in the warehouse.
lines.zh: 請注意，這是給倉庫所有人的廣播。

lines.en: From one to three today, we are installing a new heating system in the storage room.
lines.zh: 今天一點到三點，我們會在儲藏室安裝新的暖氣系統。

lines.en: The new system will control the temperature inside.
lines.zh: 新系統會控制裡面的溫度。

lines.en: While we work, the doors will remain shut to maintain the temperature.
lines.zh: 施工的時候門會一直關著，來維持溫度。

lines.en: Please do not operate any machinery or electrical equipment near the storage room.
lines.zh: 請不要在儲藏室附近操作任何機械或用電的設備。

lines.en: Also, please keep all vehicles away from the storage room door.
lines.zh: 另外，請不要讓任何車輛靠近儲藏室的門。

lines.en: The dock stays open, and the storage room opens again at three. Thank you.
lines.zh: 裝卸區照常開放，儲藏室三點重新開放。謝謝。

questions.en: When will the storage room open again?
questions.zh: 儲藏室什麼時候重新開放？

questions.en: What should people NOT do near the storage room?
questions.zh: 大家「不可以」在儲藏室附近做什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you hear that just now?
scene.zh: 你剛剛有聽到廣播嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So the storage room is closed until three?
scene.zh: 所以儲藏室要關到三點？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. They're installing a new heating system in there.
scene.zh: 對，他們要在裡面裝新的暖氣系統。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It'll control the temperature, so it's never too cold in there.
scene.zh: 它會控制溫度，裡面就不會太冷。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Until then, the doors stay shut, so we'll work out here.
scene.zh: 在那之前門都會關著，所以我們先在外面做。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And don't operate anything electrical over there, okay?
scene.zh: 還有，不要在那邊用任何電器設備，好嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What's the status of the shipment for Mr. Hughes?
scene.zh: Mr. Hughes 那批貨現在狀況怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me track it. The carrier collected it on Monday.
scene.zh: 我查一下。貨運公司星期一來收走了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's going to England by sea. Right now it's at the port.
scene.zh: 這批走海運到英國，現在在港口。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll let Ms. Carter know it's on its way.
scene.zh: 我會跟 Ms. Carter 說貨已經在路上了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. Sea transport is slow, so it'll take about four more weeks.
scene.zh: 謝了。海運比較慢，大概還要四個禮拜。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Morning! Ready for a busy day?
scene.zh: 早！準備好忙一整天了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This place is huge, so where do I start?
scene.zh: 這裡好大，我要從哪裡開始？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Start with that rack. It should contain four dozen lamps.
scene.zh: 先從那座貨架開始。上面應該有四打檯燈。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I counted again, but the numbers still don't match.
scene.zh: 我又數了一次，數字還是對不起來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, mark it on the list. I'll check it later.
scene.zh: 好，在清單上註記一下，我晚點再看。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now, this order needs packing. Wait, where are your gloves?
scene.zh: 再來，這張訂單要包裝。等等，你的手套呢？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, I wasn't aware of the rule about gloves.
scene.zh: 不好意思，我不知道有戴手套的規定。

scene.en: That's okay. They're in the cabinet by the door.
scene.zh: 沒關係，在門邊的櫃子裡。

scene.en: How are small orders like this usually packed?
scene.zh: 像這種小訂單通常怎麼包？

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 每盞燈用塑膠包好，封箱，再貼上標籤。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice work. Next, there's a rush order for downtown.
scene.zh: 做得好。再來，有一張要送市中心的急單。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which truck does this order go on?

scene.en: Truck B, in the yard. Check every box before you load it.

scene.en: Most of the order is here, but one box is missing.
scene.zh: 這張訂單的貨大部分都在，但是少了一箱。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, I left one in the storage room, and they're working in there.
scene.zh: 抱歉，我把一箱放在儲藏室了，他們正在裡面施工。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So the storage room is closed until three?
scene.zh: 所以儲藏室要關到三點？

scene.zh: 對。車子不能等，所以那箱明天再出。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What's the status of the shipment for Mr. Hughes?

scene.en: The carrier collected it last week. It weighs a lot, so it's cheaper to send by sea.
scene.zh: 貨運公司上禮拜收走了。那批很重，走海運比較便宜。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll let Ms. Carter know it's on its way.
